lint.command: uv run ruff check libs/common && uv run ruff format --check libs/common && uv run mypy libs/common/src --ignore-missing-imports --cache-dir libs/common/.mypy_cache

test.command: COVERAGE_FILE=libs/common/.coverage uv run pytest libs/common -m unit -v --tb=short --cov=libs/common --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml:libs/common/coverage.xml --cov-fail-under=80 --junitxml=libs/common/junit.xml
